defined_class: # Existing terms that match this pattern. When migrating a term from
# ecocore-edit.owl to be generated by this pattern, remove its manual
# EquivalentClasses axiom from the OWL file. The pattern will generate a
# stronger form: heterotroph AND (capable_of some diet_process).
# Note: predator, scavenger, and insectivore have more specific parents
# (carnivore, predator) than the pattern's heterotroph subClassOf — review
# those SubClassOf axioms carefully before completing migration.
